source_boundary_notes: Doxorubicin hepatic decisions use absolute bilirubin in µmol/L, not an assumed ULN of 20.
Bilirubin > 50 to < 51 µmol/L and CrCl exactly 10 mL/min are unallocated printed boundaries and require review.
CrCl exactly 50 mL/min is not assigned an ifosfamide dose by the printed table.
Current treatment-day counts and previous-cycle nadir with neutropenic fever are assessed separately.
Mucositis affects both cytotoxic components; grade ≥ 3 neurotoxicity stops ifosfamide only.
Source full-dose count thresholds differ between 00391 (> 1.5/> 100) and 00392 (≥ 1.5/≥ 100); do not copy one table to the other.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component action. Source percentages and dose levels are review instructions, not automatic prescriptions. Confirm dose history, recovery, organ function and the current official source.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00391 Version 5. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.
clinical_governance.organ_function_rule_status: Current source content reconciled in v 0.84.60; source ambiguities and independent clinical/pharmacy approval remain unresolved.

indications.description: Locally advanced unresectable or metastatic soft tissue sarcoma.

treatment.schedule_summary: Doxorubicin 20 mg/m²/day IV bolus and ifosfamide 3000 mg/m²/day IV over 3 hours on Days 1–3, every 21 days for up to 6 cycles; mesna and hydration are integral.

eligibility: Advanced unresectable or metastatic soft-tissue sarcoma.
ECOG 0–1; adequate hepatic, renal and bone-marrow function.
monitoring: Baseline full blood count, renal/liver profile and ECG; ECHO/MUGA if age > 65 or clinically indicated; source baseline LVEF > 50%.
Full blood count and renal/liver profile before each cycle.
Neurological assessment before each ifosfamide dose. Check for haematuria before each dose and every 8 hours on treatment days.
Monitor urine output, fluid balance and weight; target urine output ≥ 100 mL/hour. Review cardiac function/lifetime anthracycline exposure as indicated.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Risk assigned from the most emetogenic active component and treatment phase.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for high emetogenic risk
additional_supportive_care: G-CSF is required; prescribe the product, dose and timing using local policy.
Proton-pump inhibitor prophylaxis is specified; confirm the local prescription.

Mesna: 900 mg/m² IV before the first ifosfamide dose on Day 1, then 3000 mg/m² by continuous 24-hour infusion on Days 1–3. Confirm coverage continuing for 24 hours after ifosfamide is completed, as stated in source prose.
Hydration source example: 1000 mL sodium chloride 0.9% every 6 hours from before first ifosfamide until 24 hours after completion. Individualise for fluid status and renal/cardiac function.
Ifosfamide high and doxorubicin moderate emetogenic risk; review antiemetics and the aprepitant–ifosfamide encephalopathy interaction. No usual separate premedication.
